title: Telemetry and privacy contract (ARC-0096)
description:
Telemetry and privacy contract for this program.
SUCCESS:ARC-0096
No telemetry payload may leave the machine without an explicit owner opt-in recorded in the decision log.
When telemetry is disabled the system emits literally nothing: no outbound socket, no queued flush, and no new local telemetry record.
Local-only sink may persist allow-listed events without opt-in when enabled=true and local_recording=true. Egress (any payload leaving the machine, including localhost observers used as a sandbox stand-in for a remote collector) requires enabled=true AND a durable OPT-IN record whose scope is telemetry-egress. Configuration flags are not evidence of egress.
Every value is redacted before local persist or egress. Secrets, absolute paths, and personal data are scrubbed or the event is rejected. A write that drops the whole event is not redaction; a write that still contains the planted canary or home path is a leak.
Local telemetry records are retained at most 14 days then deleted. Egress copies are not retained on this machine after a successful POST. Disable does not flush a backlog: there is no backlog.
Owner opt-in is an append-only decision-log record with id, ts, owner, decision=OPT-IN, scope=telemetry-egress, and destination_class. Last record for that scope wins. OPT-OUT or REVOKED cancels prior OPT-IN. Absent record defaults to no egress. A test fixture labeled sandbox-only is not a production owner ruling.
Only allow-listed coded fields may be recorded: schema_version, event_id, ts, unit_id, contract_id, event_kind, outcome, phase, duration_ms, probe_id, host_os_family, error_class. Prompts, file contents, env values, hostnames, usernames, IP addresses, command lines, and free-text payloads are forbidden.
Egress is verified by an actual network observation (an observer that accepted a TCP connection), not by reading configuration. A probe silent in both enabled and disabled states measures nothing.
This document is a Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema. Used as a contract it must reject the empty object and unrelated garbage. It validates the POST-REDACTION telemetry event that may be stored locally or sent after owner opt-in. Unknown fields are forbidden. Inputs that still contain a canary secret or an absolute home path are invalid.
Upstream architecture ratification (ARC-0077) is not on disk in this worktree; the privacy rules are substrate-agnostic and do not wait on an ADV rebuild of the architecture packet.
